title: Why the Mini became a 1960s icon
author: Caramagnols
excerpt: The Mini became a 1960s icon because it combined new engineering, city use, class crossover and a clear visual identity.
content:
The Mini became an icon of the 1960s because it matched the decade without being designed as a fashion object. It was small, clever, affordable enough to be seen widely and distinctive enough to be recognised instantly.

Practical final checks

The cultural side continues in the Mini and British culture. The social angle is developed in the Mini as a social symbol.

Sources

  • BMW Group PressClub, 1959 - 2019. Sixty Years of MINI
  • MINI.com, The MINIs of The Italian Job
